decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the platform-specific effects: 5.5-inch height and edge-to-edge alignment. The 12-ounce compatibility criterion remains owned by the cup-clearance Requirement.
Matching the separate platform edge-to-edge with the machine does not change the enclosure's compactness, side profile, or bowl-well form.
The source specifies platform height and footprint alignment but does not change the machine's anti-rattle or movement-resistance requirements.
Cup clearance beneath the spouts does not alter bowl lifting, swapping, or removal clearance.
The 5.5-inch platform height concerns cup clearance beneath the machine and does not change whisk-head size, material, style, or internal positioning.
The source contains no color or font decision; the platform color requirements established earlier remain unchanged.
The supported cup size and raised-platform dimensions do not change the mixing bowls' capacity or form.
The source changes external cup clearance and platform geometry, not sealing, dripping, leakage, or liquid containment.
The platform and cup-clearance decision does not alter cleaning or removability of bowls, whisks, or spout components.
External platform height and cup fit do not change the required matcha texture, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The source does not change whisk detachment speed, removability, or tool-free preference.
Providing clearance for a 12-ounce cup below the spouts does not change the solenoid mechanism, button actuation, or closed-state dispensing behavior.
